# BUNDLE-VERIFIER-2C

Raw generated STARK verifier code for the **delegation-processor** circuits of
matter-labs/zksync-airbender @ tag v0.5.2 (commit b93c285).

Circuits included (both have `delegation_processor_layout: Some`, `delegation_request_layout: None`, `register_and_indirect_accesses` NON-EMPTY, `batched_ram_accesses: &[]`):

- `bigint_with_control` (BigInt / 256-bit modular arithmetic)
- `blake2_with_compression` (Blake2s round function)

Source files taken verbatim from `circuit_defs/<circuit>/verifier/src/`.
`quotient.rs` and `circuit_layout.rs` are given in full (not truncated).
The `multiplicity==0 => memory-access-fields cancellation` constraint is emitted
inside `unsafe fn evaluate_every_row_except_last` in each `quotient.rs`.

 62 | const fn compute_last_fri_folding_step_properties() -> (bool, usize) {
 63 |     let bound = if NUM_QUERIES.is_power_of_two() {
 64 |         NUM_QUERIES
 65 |     } else {
 66 |         NUM_QUERIES.next_power_of_two()
 67 |     };
 68 | 
 69 |     let mut last_fri_step_expose_leafs = false;
 70 |     let mut last_fri_step_leafs_total_size_per_coset = 0;
 71 | 
 72 |     let mut final_degree_log2 = TRACE_LEN_LOG2;
 73 |     let mut i = 0;
 74 |     while i < NUM_FRI_STEPS - 1 {
 75 |         final_degree_log2 -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
 76 |         i += 1;
 77 |     }
 78 | 
 79 |     let final_num_leafs = 1 << (final_degree_log2 - FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[NUM_FRI_STEPS - 1]);
 80 |     // account that we will need to put leaf hashes into transcript,
 81 |     // but also that we have cosets
 82 |     if (final_num_leafs * 2) / NUM_COSETS <= bound {
 83 |         last_fri_step_expose_leafs = true;
 84 |         last_fri_step_leafs_total_size_per_coset = 1 << final_degree_log2;
 85 |     }
 86 | 
 87 |     (
 88 |         last_fri_step_expose_leafs,
 89 |         last_fri_step_leafs_total_size_per_coset,
 90 |     )
 91 | }

101 |     let folding_schedule = [0; NUM_FRI_STEPS];

103 |     let mut final_degree_log2 = TRACE_LEN_LOG2;
104 |     let mut fri_subtree_path_len = DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH;
105 |     let mut i = 0;
106 |     while i < NUM_FRI_STEPS {
107 |         if i == NUM_FRI_STEPS - 1 {
108 |             if LAST_FRI_STEP_EXPOSE_LEAFS {
109 |                 // do not add
110 |             } else {
111 |                 total_fri_leaf_sizes += 4 * (1 << FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i]);
112 |                 fri_subtree_path_len -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
113 |                 path_lengths[i] = fri_subtree_path_len;
114 |             }
115 |         } else {
116 |             total_fri_leaf_sizes += 4 * (1 << FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i]);
117 |             fri_subtree_path_len -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
118 |             path_lengths[i] = fri_subtree_path_len;
119 |         }
120 | 
121 |         // and since we folded, next step expected degree is smaller
122 |         final_degree_log2 -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
123 |         i += 1;
124 |     }
125 | 
126 |     // Only last step length can be 0
127 |     let mut i = 0;
128 |     while i < NUM_FRI_STEPS - 1 {
129 |         assert!(path_lengths[i] > 0);
130 |         i += 1;
131 |     }
132 | 
133 |     assert!(final_degree_log2 == FOLDING_PROPERTIES.final_monomial_degree_log2);
134 | 
135 |     (folding_schedule, path_lengths, total_fri_leaf_sizes)
136 | }
137 | 
138 | const _: () = const {
139 |     let mut sum = 0;
140 |     let mut i = 0;
141 |     while i < FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE.len() {
142 |         sum += FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
143 |         i += 1;
144 |     }
145 | 
146 |     assert!(sum < TRACE_LEN_LOG2 + FRI_FACTOR_LOG2);
147 | 
148 |     ()
149 | };

280 | // we should also count a padding so that variable-length parts of the skeleton structs (like public inputs, etc),
281 | // end up in such a way, that we start "setup caps" at offset 0 mod 16, and this way everything after that will be also
282 | // aligned
283 | 
284 | pub const SKELETON_PADDING: usize = const {
285 |     let mut size = 0;
286 |     // circuit sequence
287 |     size += core::mem::size_of::<u32>();
288 |     // delegation type
289 |     size += core::mem::size_of::<u32>();
290 |     // variable number of public inputs
291 |     assert!(core::mem::size_of::<u32>() == core::mem::size_of::<Mersenne31Field>());
292 |     size += core::mem::size_of::<Mersenne31Field>() * NUM_PUBLIC_INPUTS_FROM_STATE_ELEMENTS;
293 |     let size_mod_16 = size % 16;
294 |     let required_padding_bytes = (16 - size_mod_16) % 16;
295 |     assert!(required_padding_bytes % core::mem::size_of::<u32>() == 0);
296 | 
297 |     required_padding_bytes / core::mem::size_of::<u32>()
298 | };
299 | 
300 | pub const MAX_FRI_FOLDING_ROOTS: usize = 1 << 4;
301 | pub const SHARED_FACTORS_FOR_FOLDING: [Mersenne31Complex; MAX_FRI_FOLDING_ROOTS] = const {
302 |     let max_generator = Mersenne31Complex::TWO_ADICITY_GENERATORS_INVERSED[5];
303 |     let mut result = [Mersenne31Complex::ZERO; MAX_FRI_FOLDING_ROOTS];
304 |     let mut i = 0;
305 |     let mut current = Mersenne31Complex::ONE;
306 |     while i < MAX_FRI_FOLDING_ROOTS {
307 |         let index = i.reverse_bits() >> (usize::BITS - 4);
308 |         result[index] = current;
309 |         current.mul_assign_impl(&max_generator);
310 |         i += 1;
311 |     }
312 | 
313 |     result
314 | };

305 |                     / core::mem::size_of::<u32>(),
306 |             );
307 |             let cap_size_u32_words =
308 |                 core::mem::size_of::<[MerkleTreeCap<TREE_CAP_SIZE>; NUM_COSETS]>()
309 |                     / core::mem::size_of::<u32>();
310 | 
311 |             core::array::from_fn(|i| {
312 |                 let start = start_of_oracles.add(i * cap_size_u32_words);
313 |                 let end = start.add(cap_size_u32_words);
314 |                 core::slice::from_ptr_range(start..end)
315 |             })
316 |         }
317 |     }

319 |     pub fn transcript_elements_last_fri_step_leaf_values(&'_ self) -> &'_ [u32] {
320 |         unsafe {
321 |             let start_of_oracles = (self as *const Self).cast::<u32>().add(
322 |                 offset_of!(ProofSkeletonInstance, fri_final_step_leafs)
323 |                     / core::mem::size_of::<u32>(),
324 |             );
325 |             let set_size_u32_words = core::mem::size_of::<
326 |                 [[Mersenne31Quartic; LAST_FRI_STEP_LEAFS_TOTAL_SIZE_PER_COSET]; NUM_COSETS],
327 |             >() / core::mem::size_of::<u32>();
328 | 
329 |             let start = start_of_oracles;
330 |             let end = start.add(set_size_u32_words);
331 |             // those are reduced when we read them
332 |             core::slice::from_ptr_range(start..end)
333 |         }
334 |     }

336 |     pub fn transcript_elements_monomial_coefficients(&'_ self) -> &'_ [u32] {
337 |         unsafe {
338 |             let start = (self as *const Self).cast::<u32>().add(
339 |                 offset_of!(ProofSkeletonInstance, monomial_coeffs) / core::mem::size_of::<u32>(),
340 |             );
341 |             let len =
342 |                 field_size!(ProofSkeletonInstance::monomial_coeffs) / core::mem::size_of::<u32>();
343 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(start, len)
344 |         }
345 |     }
346 | }
347 | 
348 | impl QueryValuesInstance {
349 |     #[inline(never)]
350 |     pub unsafe fn fill<I: NonDeterminismSource, V: LeafInclusionVerifier>(
351 |         this: *mut Self,
352 |         proof_skeleton: &ProofSkeletonInstance,
353 |         hasher: &mut V,
354 |     ) {
355 |         let dst = this.cast::<u32>();
356 |         let modulus = Mersenne31Field::CHARACTERISTICS as u32;
357 |         // query index
358 |         let query_index = I::read_word();
359 |         assert!(
360 |             query_index < (1u32 << BITS_FOR_QUERY_INDEX),
361 |             "query index 0x{:08x} must be smaller than 0x{:08x}",
362 |             query_index,
363 |             1u32 << BITS_FOR_QUERY_INDEX
364 |         );
365 |         dst.write(query_index);
366 |         let mut i = 1;
367 |         // leaf values are field elements
368 |         while i < BASE_CIRCUIT_QUERY_VALUES_NO_PADDING_U32_WORDS {
369 |             // field elements mut be reduced in full
370 |             dst.add(i).write(I::read_reduced_field_element(modulus));
371 |             i += 1;
372 |         }
373 | 
374 |         // for all except FRI the following is valid
375 |         let tree_index = query_index & TREE_INDEX_MASK;
376 |         let coset_index = query_index >> TRACE_LEN_LOG2;
377 |         // and now we should optimistically verify each leaf over the corresponding merkle cap
378 | 
379 |         let setup_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
380 |             coset_index,
381 |             tree_index,
382 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
383 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
384 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().setup_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
385 |                 LEAF_SIZE_SETUP,
386 |             ),
387 |             &proof_skeleton.setup_caps,
388 |         );
389 |         assert!(setup_included);
390 | 
391 |         let witness_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
392 |             coset_index,
393 |             tree_index,
394 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
395 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
396 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().witness_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
397 |                 LEAF_SIZE_WITNESS_TREE,
398 |             ),
399 |             &proof_skeleton.witness_caps,
400 |         );
401 |         assert!(witness_included);
402 | 
403 |         let memory_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
404 |             coset_index,
405 |             tree_index,
406 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
407 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
408 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().memory_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
409 |                 LEAF_SIZE_MEMORY_TREE,
410 |             ),
411 |             &proof_skeleton.memory_caps,
412 |         );
413 |         assert!(memory_included);
414 | 
415 |         let stage_2_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
416 |             coset_index,
417 |             tree_index,
418 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
419 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
420 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().stage_2_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
421 |                 LEAF_SIZE_STAGE_2,
422 |             ),
423 |             &proof_skeleton.stage_2_caps,
424 |         );
425 |         assert!(stage_2_included);
426 | 
427 |         let quotient_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
428 |             coset_index,
429 |             tree_index,
430 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
431 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
432 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().quotient_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
433 |                 LEAF_SIZE_QUOTIENT,
434 |             ),
435 |             &proof_skeleton.quotient_caps,
436 |         );
437 |         assert!(quotient_included);
438 | 
439 |         let mut fri_tree_index = tree_index;
440 |         let mut fri_path_length = DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH;
441 |         let mut fri_leaf_start = this.as_ref_unchecked().fri_oracles_leafs.as_ptr();
442 |         for fri_step in 0..NUM_FRI_STEPS_WITH_ORACLES {
443 |             let caps = &proof_skeleton.fri_intermediate_oracles[fri_step];
444 |             fri_tree_index >>= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[fri_step];
445 |             fri_path_length -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[fri_step];
446 |             let leaf_size = 4 * (1 << FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[fri_step]);
447 |             let fri_oracle_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
448 |                 coset_index,
449 |                 fri_tree_index,
450 |                 fri_path_length,
451 |                 core::slice::from_raw_parts(fri_leaf_start.cast::<u32>(), leaf_size),
452 |                 caps,
453 |             );
454 |             assert!(fri_oracle_included);
455 | 
456 |             fri_leaf_start = fri_leaf_start.add(leaf_size);
457 |         }
458 |     }
459 | 
460 |     pub unsafe fn fill_array<I: NonDeterminismSource, V: LeafInclusionVerifier, const N: usize>(
461 |         dst: *mut [Self; N],
462 |         proof_skeleton: &ProofSkeletonInstance,
463 |         hasher: &mut V,
464 |     ) {
465 |         let dst = dst.cast::<Self>();
466 |         let mut i = 0;
467 |         while i < N {
468 |             Self::fill::<I, V>(dst.add(i), proof_skeleton, hasher);
469 |             i += 1;
470 |         }
471 |     }
472 | }

  4 | pub(crate) unsafe fn precompute_for_consistency_checks(
  5 |     skeleton: &ProofSkeletonInstance,
  6 |     deep_poly_alpha: &Mersenne31Quartic,
  7 |     powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge: &mut [Mersenne31Quartic;
  8 |              NUM_OPENINGS_AT_Z + NUM_OPENINGS_AT_Z_OMEGA],
  9 | ) -> (Mersenne31Quartic, Mersenne31Quartic) {
 10 |     let mut precompute_with_evals_at_z = Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO;
 11 |     let mut precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega = Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO;
 12 |     let mut current = Mersenne31Quartic::ONE;
 13 |     let mut i = 0;
 14 |     for eval_at_z in skeleton.openings_at_z.iter() {
 15 |         *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked_mut(i) = current;
 16 |         i += 1;
 17 |         let mut t = current;
 18 |         t.mul_assign(&eval_at_z);
 19 |         precompute_with_evals_at_z.add_assign(&t);
 20 |         current.mul_assign(&deep_poly_alpha);
 21 |     }
 22 |     for eval_at_z_omega in skeleton.openings_at_z_omega.iter() {
 23 |         *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked_mut(i) = current;
 24 |         i += 1;
 25 |         let mut t = current;
 26 |         t.mul_assign(&eval_at_z_omega);
 27 |         precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega.add_assign(&t);
 28 |         current.mul_assign(&deep_poly_alpha);
 29 |     }
 30 | 
 31 |     (precompute_with_evals_at_z, precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega)
 32 | }

 34 | pub(crate) unsafe fn precompute_for_consistency_checks_with_fma(
 35 |     skeleton: &ProofSkeletonInstance,
 36 |     deep_poly_alpha: &Mersenne31Quartic,
 37 |     extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega: &mut Mersenne31Quartic,
 38 | ) -> (Mersenne31Quartic, Mersenne31Quartic) {
 39 |     // here we should inverse the Horner rule (walk backwards)
 40 |     let num_evals_at_z = skeleton.openings_at_z.len();
 41 | 
 42 |     // our FMA is a*b + c -> a, so our best strategy with least copies is to
 43 |     // start from the very end, keep current value in `a`, and then scale it by challenge and
 44 |     // add the new value. Last iteration will need to be placed out of the loop
 45 | 
 46 |     let mut i = num_evals_at_z;
 47 |     let mut precompute_with_evals_at_z = core::hint::black_box(Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO);
 48 |     while i > 0 {
 49 |         i -= 1;
 50 |         let eval_to_add = skeleton.openings_at_z.get_unchecked(i);
 51 |         Mersenne31Quartic::fused_mul_add_assign(
 52 |             &mut precompute_with_evals_at_z,
 53 |             deep_poly_alpha,
 54 |             eval_to_add,
 55 |         );
 56 |     }
 57 | 
 58 |     let mut i = skeleton.openings_at_z_omega.len();
 59 |     let mut precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega = core::hint::black_box(Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO);
 60 |     while i > 0 {
 61 |         i -= 1;
 62 |         let eval_to_add = skeleton.openings_at_z_omega.get_unchecked(i);
 63 |         Mersenne31Quartic::fused_mul_add_assign(
 64 |             &mut precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega,
 65 |             deep_poly_alpha,
 66 |             eval_to_add,
 67 |         );
 68 |     }
 69 | 
 70 |     // multiply by extra power
 71 |     *extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega = deep_poly_alpha.pow_with_fma(num_evals_at_z as u32);
 72 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega
 73 |         .mul_assign_with_fma(&*extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega);
 74 | 
 75 |     (precompute_with_evals_at_z, precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega)
 76 | }

 78 | pub(crate) unsafe fn accumulate_over_row_for_consistency_check(
 79 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z: Mersenne31Quartic,
 80 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega: Mersenne31Quartic,
 81 |     query: &QueryValuesInstance,
 82 |     powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge: &[Mersenne31Quartic;
 83 |          NUM_OPENINGS_AT_Z + NUM_OPENINGS_AT_Z_OMEGA],
 84 |     divisor_for_z: &Mersenne31Quartic,
 85 |     divisor_for_z_omega: &Mersenne31Quartic,
 86 |     tau_in_domain_by_half: &Mersenne31Complex,
 87 |     tau_in_domain_by_half_inversed: &Mersenne31Complex,
 88 | ) -> Mersenne31Quartic {
 89 |     // now we can do consistency check
 90 |     let mut accumulated_at_z = Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO;
 91 | 
 92 |     // setup, then witness, then memory, then stage 2 base, then stage 2 ext, then quotient
 93 |     let mut i = 0;
 94 |     for leaf_el in query.setup_leaf.iter() {
 95 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
 96 |         i += 1;
 97 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
 98 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
 99 |     }
100 | 
101 |     for leaf_el in query.witness_leaf.iter() {
102 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
103 |         i += 1;
104 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
105 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
106 |     }
107 | 
108 |     for leaf_el in query.memory_leaf.iter() {
109 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
110 |         i += 1;
111 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
112 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
113 |     }
114 | 
115 |     for leaf_el in query.stage_2_leaf[..VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
116 |         .stage_2_layout
117 |         .num_base_field_polys()]
118 |         .iter()
119 |     {
120 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
121 |         i += 1;
122 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
123 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
124 |     }
125 | 
126 |     for leaf_el in query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset..]
127 |         .as_chunks::<4>()
128 |         .0
129 |         .iter()
130 |     {
131 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
132 |         let leaf_el = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(*leaf_el);
133 |         i += 1;
134 |         t.mul_assign(&leaf_el);
135 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
136 |     }
137 | 
138 |     // quotient is just a single value
139 |     {
140 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
141 |         let leaf_el = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(query.quotient_leaf);
142 |         i += 1;
143 |         t.mul_assign(&leaf_el);
144 |         // NOTE: we compute quotient at non-main domain first, and then LDE, so we do NOT have adjustment
145 |         // there, and we should cancel one below
146 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half_inversed);
147 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
148 |     }
149 | 
150 |     // all terms are linear over leaf values, so it's enough to scale once
151 |     accumulated_at_z.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half);
152 | 
153 |     let mut simulated_from_z = precompute_with_evals_at_z;
154 |     simulated_from_z.sub_assign(&accumulated_at_z);
155 |     simulated_from_z.mul_assign(&divisor_for_z);
156 | 
157 |     let mut accumulated_at_z_omega = Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO;
158 | 
159 |     for index in WITNESS_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.iter() {
160 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
161 |         let leaf_el = query.witness_leaf.get_unchecked(*index);
162 |         i += 1;
163 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
164 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.add_assign(&t);
165 |     }
166 |     for index in MEMORY_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.iter() {
167 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
168 |         let leaf_el = query.memory_leaf.get_unchecked(*index);
169 |         i += 1;
170 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
171 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.add_assign(&t);
172 |     }
173 |     // single element for stage 2
174 |     {
175 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
176 |         let leaf_el =
177 |             query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset
178 |                 + (MEMORY_GRAND_PRODUCT_ACCUMULATOR_POLY_INDEX
179 |                     - VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
180 |                         .stage_2_layout
181 |                         .num_base_field_polys())
182 |                     * 4..]
183 |                 .as_chunks::<4>()
184 |                 .0
185 |                 .iter()
186 |                 .next()
187 |                 .unwrap_unchecked();
188 |         let leaf_el = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(*leaf_el);
189 |         t.mul_assign(&leaf_el);
190 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.add_assign(&t);
191 |     }
192 | 
193 |     // all terms are linear over leaf values, so it's enough to scale once
194 |     accumulated_at_z_omega.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half);
195 | 
196 |     let mut simulated_from_z_omega = precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega;
197 |     simulated_from_z_omega.sub_assign(&accumulated_at_z_omega);
198 |     simulated_from_z_omega.mul_assign(&divisor_for_z_omega);
199 | 
200 |     let mut expected_value = simulated_from_z;
201 |     expected_value.add_assign(&simulated_from_z_omega);
202 | 
203 |     expected_value
204 | }

206 | pub(crate) unsafe fn accumulate_over_row_for_consistency_check_with_fma(
207 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z: Mersenne31Quartic,
208 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega: Mersenne31Quartic,
209 |     query: &QueryValuesInstance,
210 |     deep_poly_alpha: &Mersenne31Quartic,
211 |     extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega: &Mersenne31Quartic,
212 |     divisor_for_z: &Mersenne31Quartic,
213 |     divisor_for_z_omega: &Mersenne31Quartic,
214 |     tau_in_domain_by_half: &Mersenne31Complex,
215 |     tau_in_domain_by_half_inversed: &Mersenne31Complex,
216 | ) -> Mersenne31Quartic {
217 |     assert!(Mersenne31Quartic::CAN_PROJECT_FROM_BASE);
218 | 
219 |     // now we can do consistency check
220 |     let mut accumulated_at_z;
221 | 
222 |     // it's effectively a Horner rule as we walk backwards
223 | 
224 |     // setup, then witness, then memory, then stage 2 base, then stage 2 ext, then quotient,
225 |     // but all backwards
226 | 
227 |     // quotient is just a single value
228 |     {
229 |         accumulated_at_z = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(query.quotient_leaf);
230 |         // NOTE: we compute quotient at non-main domain first, and then LDE, so we do NOT have adjustment
231 |         // there, and we should cancel one below
232 |         accumulated_at_z.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half_inversed);
233 |     }
234 | 
235 |     let src_ptr = query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset..]
236 |         .as_ptr()
237 |         .cast::<[Mersenne31Field; 4]>();
238 |     let mut i =
239 |         query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset..].len() / 4;
240 |     while i > 0 {
241 |         i -= 1;
242 |         let leaf_el = Mersenne31Quartic::project_ref_from_array(src_ptr.add(i).as_ref_unchecked());
243 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, leaf_el);
244 |     }
245 | 
246 |     // all elements below are in "base field", so we will use an out of cycle value to copy those into for FMA
247 | 
248 |     let mut leaf_value = core::hint::black_box(Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO);
249 | 
250 |     let mut i = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
251 |         .stage_2_layout
252 |         .num_base_field_polys();
253 |     while i > 0 {
254 |         i -= 1;
255 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.stage_2_leaf.get_unchecked(i);
256 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
257 |     }
258 | 
259 |     let mut i = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.memory_layout.total_width;
260 |     while i > 0 {
261 |         i -= 1;
262 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.memory_leaf.get_unchecked(i);
263 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
264 |     }
265 | 
266 |     let mut i = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.witness_layout.total_width;
267 |     while i > 0 {
268 |         i -= 1;
269 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.witness_leaf.get_unchecked(i);
270 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
271 |     }
272 | 
273 |     let mut i = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.setup_layout.total_width;
274 |     while i > 0 {
275 |         i -= 1;
276 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.setup_leaf.get_unchecked(i);
277 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
278 |     }
279 | 
280 |     // all terms are linear over leaf values, so it's enough to scale once
281 |     accumulated_at_z.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half);
282 | 
283 |     let mut simulated_from_z = precompute_with_evals_at_z;
284 |     simulated_from_z.sub_assign(&accumulated_at_z);
285 |     simulated_from_z.mul_assign(&divisor_for_z);
286 | 
287 |     let mut accumulated_at_z_omega;
288 |     // normal sequence is witness - memory - stage 2, so we should reverse for Horner rule
289 | 
290 |     // single element for stage 2
291 |     {
292 |         let leaf_el =
293 |             query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset
294 |                 + (MEMORY_GRAND_PRODUCT_ACCUMULATOR_POLY_INDEX
295 |                     - VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
296 |                         .stage_2_layout
297 |                         .num_base_field_polys())
298 |                     * 4..]
299 |                 .as_chunks::<4>()
300 |                 .0
301 |                 .iter()
302 |                 .next()
303 |                 .unwrap_unchecked();
304 |         accumulated_at_z_omega = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(*leaf_el);
305 |     }
306 | 
307 |     // memory
308 |     let mut i = MEMORY_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.len();
309 |     while i > 0 {
310 |         i -= 1;
311 |         let index = *MEMORY_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.get_unchecked(i);
312 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.memory_leaf.get_unchecked(index);
313 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
314 |     }
315 | 
316 |     // witness
317 |     let mut i = WITNESS_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.len();
318 |     while i > 0 {
319 |         i -= 1;
320 |         let index = *WITNESS_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.get_unchecked(i);
321 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.witness_leaf.get_unchecked(index);
322 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
323 |     }
324 | 
325 |     accumulated_at_z_omega.mul_assign_with_fma(extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega);
326 | 
327 |     // all terms are linear over leaf values, so it's enough to scale once
328 |     accumulated_at_z_omega.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half);
329 | 
330 |     let mut simulated_from_z_omega = precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega;
331 |     simulated_from_z_omega.sub_assign(&accumulated_at_z_omega);
332 |     simulated_from_z_omega.mul_assign(&divisor_for_z_omega);
333 | 
334 |     let mut expected_value = simulated_from_z;
335 |     expected_value.add_assign(&simulated_from_z_omega);
336 | 
337 |     expected_value
338 | }

 62 | const fn compute_last_fri_folding_step_properties() -> (bool, usize) {
 63 |     let bound = if NUM_QUERIES.is_power_of_two() {
 64 |         NUM_QUERIES
 65 |     } else {
 66 |         NUM_QUERIES.next_power_of_two()
 67 |     };
 68 | 
 69 |     let mut last_fri_step_expose_leafs = false;
 70 |     let mut last_fri_step_leafs_total_size_per_coset = 0;
 71 | 
 72 |     let mut final_degree_log2 = TRACE_LEN_LOG2;
 73 |     let mut i = 0;
 74 |     while i < NUM_FRI_STEPS - 1 {
 75 |         final_degree_log2 -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
 76 |         i += 1;
 77 |     }
 78 | 
 79 |     let final_num_leafs = 1 << (final_degree_log2 - FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[NUM_FRI_STEPS - 1]);
 80 |     // account that we will need to put leaf hashes into transcript,
 81 |     // but also that we have cosets
 82 |     if (final_num_leafs * 2) / NUM_COSETS <= bound {
 83 |         last_fri_step_expose_leafs = true;
 84 |         last_fri_step_leafs_total_size_per_coset = 1 << final_degree_log2;
 85 |     }
 86 | 
 87 |     (
 88 |         last_fri_step_expose_leafs,
 89 |         last_fri_step_leafs_total_size_per_coset,
 90 |     )
 91 | }

 93 | pub const LAST_FRI_STEP_EXPOSE_LEAFS: bool = compute_last_fri_folding_step_properties().0;
 94 | pub const LAST_FRI_STEP_LEAFS_TOTAL_SIZE_PER_COSET: usize =
 95 |     compute_last_fri_folding_step_properties().1;

 98 | const fn compute_fri_folding_properties() -> ([usize; NUM_FRI_STEPS], [usize; NUM_FRI_STEPS], usize)
 99 | {
100 |     let mut total_fri_leaf_sizes = 0;
101 |     let folding_schedule = [0; NUM_FRI_STEPS];
102 |     let mut path_lengths = [0usize; NUM_FRI_STEPS];
103 |     let mut final_degree_log2 = TRACE_LEN_LOG2;
104 |     let mut fri_subtree_path_len = DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH;
105 |     let mut i = 0;
106 |     while i < NUM_FRI_STEPS {
107 |         if i == NUM_FRI_STEPS - 1 {
108 |             if LAST_FRI_STEP_EXPOSE_LEAFS {
109 |                 // do not add
110 |             } else {
111 |                 total_fri_leaf_sizes += 4 * (1 << FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i]);
112 |                 fri_subtree_path_len -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
113 |                 path_lengths[i] = fri_subtree_path_len;
114 |             }
115 |         } else {
116 |             total_fri_leaf_sizes += 4 * (1 << FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i]);
117 |             fri_subtree_path_len -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
118 |             path_lengths[i] = fri_subtree_path_len;
119 |         }
120 | 
121 |         // and since we folded, next step expected degree is smaller
122 |         final_degree_log2 -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[i];
123 |         i += 1;
124 |     }
125 | 
126 |     // Only last step length can be 0
127 |     let mut i = 0;
128 |     while i < NUM_FRI_STEPS - 1 {
129 |         assert!(path_lengths[i] > 0);
130 |         i += 1;
131 |     }
132 | 
133 |     assert!(final_degree_log2 == FOLDING_PROPERTIES.final_monomial_degree_log2);
134 | 
135 |     (folding_schedule, path_lengths, total_fri_leaf_sizes)
136 | }

143 |         i += 1;
144 |     }
145 | 
146 |     assert!(sum < TRACE_LEN_LOG2 + FRI_FACTOR_LOG2);
147 |

265 | pub const CIRCUIT_SEQUENCE_BITS_SHIFT: usize = (TRACE_LEN_LOG2
266 |     + NUM_BITS_IN_TIMESTAMP_FOR_INDEX_LOG_2)
267 |     - (TIMESTAMP_COLUMNS_NUM_BITS as usize);
268 | 
269 | pub const MEMORY_GRAND_PRODUCT_ACCUMULATOR_OFFSET: usize = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
270 |     .stage_2_layout
271 |     .intermediate_polys_for_memory_argument
272 |     .num_elements()
273 |     - 1;
274 | pub const MEMORY_GRAND_PRODUCT_ACCUMULATOR_POLY_INDEX: usize = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
275 |     .stage_2_layout
276 |     .get_intermediate_polys_for_memory_argument_absolute_poly_idx_for_verifier(
277 |         MEMORY_GRAND_PRODUCT_ACCUMULATOR_OFFSET,
278 |     );
279 | 
280 | // we should also count a padding so that variable-length parts of the skeleton structs (like public inputs, etc),
281 | // end up in such a way, that we start "setup caps" at offset 0 mod 16, and this way everything after that will be also
282 | // aligned
283 | 
284 | pub const SKELETON_PADDING: usize = const {
285 |     let mut size = 0;
286 |     // circuit sequence
287 |     size += core::mem::size_of::<u32>();
288 |     // delegation type
289 |     size += core::mem::size_of::<u32>();
290 |     // variable number of public inputs
291 |     assert!(core::mem::size_of::<u32>() == core::mem::size_of::<Mersenne31Field>());
292 |     size += core::mem::size_of::<Mersenne31Field>() * NUM_PUBLIC_INPUTS_FROM_STATE_ELEMENTS;
293 |     let size_mod_16 = size % 16;
294 |     let required_padding_bytes = (16 - size_mod_16) % 16;
295 |     assert!(required_padding_bytes % core::mem::size_of::<u32>() == 0);
296 | 
297 |     required_padding_bytes / core::mem::size_of::<u32>()
298 | };
299 | 
300 | pub const MAX_FRI_FOLDING_ROOTS: usize = 1 << 4;
301 | pub const SHARED_FACTORS_FOR_FOLDING: [Mersenne31Complex; MAX_FRI_FOLDING_ROOTS] = const {
302 |     let max_generator = Mersenne31Complex::TWO_ADICITY_GENERATORS_INVERSED[5];
303 |     let mut result = [Mersenne31Complex::ZERO; MAX_FRI_FOLDING_ROOTS];
304 |     let mut i = 0;
305 |     let mut current = Mersenne31Complex::ONE;
306 |     while i < MAX_FRI_FOLDING_ROOTS {
307 |         let index = i.reverse_bits() >> (usize::BITS - 4);
308 |         result[index] = current;
309 |         current.mul_assign_impl(&max_generator);
310 |         i += 1;
311 |     }
312 | 
313 |     result
314 | };

348 | impl QueryValuesInstance {
349 |     #[inline(never)]
350 |     pub unsafe fn fill<I: NonDeterminismSource, V: LeafInclusionVerifier>(
351 |         this: *mut Self,
352 |         proof_skeleton: &ProofSkeletonInstance,
353 |         hasher: &mut V,
354 |     ) {
355 |         let dst = this.cast::<u32>();
356 |         let modulus = Mersenne31Field::CHARACTERISTICS as u32;
357 |         // query index
358 |         let query_index = I::read_word();
359 |         assert!(
360 |             query_index < (1u32 << BITS_FOR_QUERY_INDEX),
361 |             "query index 0x{:08x} must be smaller than 0x{:08x}",
362 |             query_index,
363 |             1u32 << BITS_FOR_QUERY_INDEX
364 |         );
365 |         dst.write(query_index);
366 |         let mut i = 1;
367 |         // leaf values are field elements
368 |         while i < BASE_CIRCUIT_QUERY_VALUES_NO_PADDING_U32_WORDS {
369 |             // field elements mut be reduced in full
370 |             dst.add(i).write(I::read_reduced_field_element(modulus));
371 |             i += 1;
372 |         }
373 | 
374 |         // for all except FRI the following is valid
375 |         let tree_index = query_index & TREE_INDEX_MASK;
376 |         let coset_index = query_index >> TRACE_LEN_LOG2;
377 |         // and now we should optimistically verify each leaf over the corresponding merkle cap
378 | 
379 |         let setup_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
380 |             coset_index,
381 |             tree_index,
382 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
383 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
384 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().setup_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
385 |                 LEAF_SIZE_SETUP,
386 |             ),
387 |             &proof_skeleton.setup_caps,
388 |         );
389 |         assert!(setup_included);
390 | 
391 |         let witness_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
392 |             coset_index,
393 |             tree_index,
394 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
395 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
396 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().witness_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
397 |                 LEAF_SIZE_WITNESS_TREE,
398 |             ),
399 |             &proof_skeleton.witness_caps,
400 |         );
401 |         assert!(witness_included);
402 | 
403 |         let memory_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
404 |             coset_index,
405 |             tree_index,
406 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
407 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
408 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().memory_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
409 |                 LEAF_SIZE_MEMORY_TREE,
410 |             ),
411 |             &proof_skeleton.memory_caps,
412 |         );
413 |         assert!(memory_included);
414 | 
415 |         let stage_2_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
416 |             coset_index,
417 |             tree_index,
418 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
419 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
420 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().stage_2_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
421 |                 LEAF_SIZE_STAGE_2,
422 |             ),
423 |             &proof_skeleton.stage_2_caps,
424 |         );
425 |         assert!(stage_2_included);
426 | 
427 |         let quotient_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
428 |             coset_index,
429 |             tree_index,
430 |             DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH,
431 |             core::slice::from_raw_parts(
432 |                 this.as_ref_unchecked().quotient_leaf.as_ptr().cast::<u32>(),
433 |                 LEAF_SIZE_QUOTIENT,
434 |             ),
435 |             &proof_skeleton.quotient_caps,
436 |         );
437 |         assert!(quotient_included);
438 | 
439 |         let mut fri_tree_index = tree_index;
440 |         let mut fri_path_length = DEFAULT_MERKLE_PATH_LENGTH;
441 |         let mut fri_leaf_start = this.as_ref_unchecked().fri_oracles_leafs.as_ptr();
442 |         for fri_step in 0..NUM_FRI_STEPS_WITH_ORACLES {
443 |             let caps = &proof_skeleton.fri_intermediate_oracles[fri_step];
444 |             fri_tree_index >>= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[fri_step];
445 |             fri_path_length -= FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[fri_step];
446 |             let leaf_size = 4 * (1 << FRI_FOLDING_SCHEDULE[fri_step]);
447 |             let fri_oracle_included = hasher.verify_leaf_inclusion::<I, TREE_CAP_SIZE, NUM_COSETS>(
448 |                 coset_index,
449 |                 fri_tree_index,
450 |                 fri_path_length,
451 |                 core::slice::from_raw_parts(fri_leaf_start.cast::<u32>(), leaf_size),
452 |                 caps,
453 |             );
454 |             assert!(fri_oracle_included);
455 | 
456 |             fri_leaf_start = fri_leaf_start.add(leaf_size);
457 |         }
458 |     }
459 | 
460 |     pub unsafe fn fill_array<I: NonDeterminismSource, V: LeafInclusionVerifier, const N: usize>(
461 |         dst: *mut [Self; N],
462 |         proof_skeleton: &ProofSkeletonInstance,
463 |         hasher: &mut V,
464 |     ) {
465 |         let dst = dst.cast::<Self>();
466 |         let mut i = 0;
467 |         while i < N {
468 |             Self::fill::<I, V>(dst.add(i), proof_skeleton, hasher);
469 |             i += 1;
470 |         }
471 |     }
472 | }
```

  4 | pub(crate) unsafe fn precompute_for_consistency_checks(
  5 |     skeleton: &ProofSkeletonInstance,
  6 |     deep_poly_alpha: &Mersenne31Quartic,
  7 |     powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge: &mut [Mersenne31Quartic;
  8 |              NUM_OPENINGS_AT_Z + NUM_OPENINGS_AT_Z_OMEGA],
  9 | ) -> (Mersenne31Quartic, Mersenne31Quartic) {
 10 |     let mut precompute_with_evals_at_z = Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO;
 11 |     let mut precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega = Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO;
 12 |     let mut current = Mersenne31Quartic::ONE;
 13 |     let mut i = 0;
 14 |     for eval_at_z in skeleton.openings_at_z.iter() {
 15 |         *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked_mut(i) = current;
 16 |         i += 1;
 17 |         let mut t = current;
 18 |         t.mul_assign(&eval_at_z);
 19 |         precompute_with_evals_at_z.add_assign(&t);
 20 |         current.mul_assign(&deep_poly_alpha);
 21 |     }
 22 |     for eval_at_z_omega in skeleton.openings_at_z_omega.iter() {
 23 |         *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked_mut(i) = current;
 24 |         i += 1;
 25 |         let mut t = current;
 26 |         t.mul_assign(&eval_at_z_omega);
 27 |         precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega.add_assign(&t);
 28 |         current.mul_assign(&deep_poly_alpha);
 29 |     }
 30 | 
 31 |     (precompute_with_evals_at_z, precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega)
 32 | }

 34 | pub(crate) unsafe fn precompute_for_consistency_checks_with_fma(
 35 |     skeleton: &ProofSkeletonInstance,
 36 |     deep_poly_alpha: &Mersenne31Quartic,
 37 |     extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega: &mut Mersenne31Quartic,
 38 | ) -> (Mersenne31Quartic, Mersenne31Quartic) {
 39 |     // here we should inverse the Horner rule (walk backwards)
 40 |     let num_evals_at_z = skeleton.openings_at_z.len();
 41 | 
 42 |     // our FMA is a*b + c -> a, so our best strategy with least copies is to
 43 |     // start from the very end, keep current value in `a`, and then scale it by challenge and
 44 |     // add the new value. Last iteration will need to be placed out of the loop
 45 | 
 46 |     let mut i = num_evals_at_z;
 47 |     let mut precompute_with_evals_at_z = core::hint::black_box(Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO);
 48 |     while i > 0 {
 49 |         i -= 1;
 50 |         let eval_to_add = skeleton.openings_at_z.get_unchecked(i);
 51 |         Mersenne31Quartic::fused_mul_add_assign(
 52 |             &mut precompute_with_evals_at_z,
 53 |             deep_poly_alpha,
 54 |             eval_to_add,
 55 |         );
 56 |     }
 57 | 
 58 |     let mut i = skeleton.openings_at_z_omega.len();
 59 |     let mut precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega = core::hint::black_box(Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO);
 60 |     while i > 0 {
 61 |         i -= 1;
 62 |         let eval_to_add = skeleton.openings_at_z_omega.get_unchecked(i);
 63 |         Mersenne31Quartic::fused_mul_add_assign(
 64 |             &mut precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega,
 65 |             deep_poly_alpha,
 66 |             eval_to_add,
 67 |         );
 68 |     }
 69 | 
 70 |     // multiply by extra power
 71 |     *extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega = deep_poly_alpha.pow_with_fma(num_evals_at_z as u32);
 72 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega
 73 |         .mul_assign_with_fma(&*extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega);
 74 | 
 75 |     (precompute_with_evals_at_z, precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega)
 76 | }

 78 | pub(crate) unsafe fn accumulate_over_row_for_consistency_check(
 79 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z: Mersenne31Quartic,
 80 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega: Mersenne31Quartic,
 81 |     query: &QueryValuesInstance,
 82 |     powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge: &[Mersenne31Quartic;
 83 |          NUM_OPENINGS_AT_Z + NUM_OPENINGS_AT_Z_OMEGA],

 87 |     tau_in_domain_by_half_inversed: &Mersenne31Complex,
 88 | ) -> Mersenne31Quartic {
 89 |     // now we can do consistency check
 90 |     let mut accumulated_at_z = Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO;
 91 | 
 92 |     // setup, then witness, then memory, then stage 2 base, then stage 2 ext, then quotient
 93 |     let mut i = 0;

 95 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);

 97 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);

 99 |     }
100 | 
101 |     for leaf_el in query.witness_leaf.iter() {
102 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
103 |         i += 1;
104 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
105 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
106 |     }
107 | 
108 |     for leaf_el in query.memory_leaf.iter() {
109 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
110 |         i += 1;
111 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
112 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
113 |     }
114 | 
115 |     for leaf_el in query.stage_2_leaf[..VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
116 |         .stage_2_layout
117 |         .num_base_field_polys()]
118 |         .iter()
119 |     {
120 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
121 |         i += 1;
122 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
123 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
124 |     }
125 | 
126 |     for leaf_el in query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset..]
127 |         .as_chunks::<4>()
128 |         .0
129 |         .iter()
130 |     {
131 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
132 |         let leaf_el = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(*leaf_el);
133 |         i += 1;
134 |         t.mul_assign(&leaf_el);
135 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
136 |     }
137 | 
138 |     // quotient is just a single value
139 |     {
140 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
141 |         let leaf_el = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(query.quotient_leaf);
142 |         i += 1;
143 |         t.mul_assign(&leaf_el);
144 |         // NOTE: we compute quotient at non-main domain first, and then LDE, so we do NOT have adjustment
145 |         // there, and we should cancel one below
146 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half_inversed);
147 |         accumulated_at_z.add_assign(&t);
148 |     }
149 | 
150 |     // all terms are linear over leaf values, so it's enough to scale once
151 |     accumulated_at_z.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half);
152 | 
153 |     let mut simulated_from_z = precompute_with_evals_at_z;
154 |     simulated_from_z.sub_assign(&accumulated_at_z);
155 |     simulated_from_z.mul_assign(&divisor_for_z);
156 | 
157 |     let mut accumulated_at_z_omega = Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO;
158 | 
159 |     for index in WITNESS_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.iter() {
160 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
161 |         let leaf_el = query.witness_leaf.get_unchecked(*index);
162 |         i += 1;
163 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
164 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.add_assign(&t);
165 |     }
166 |     for index in MEMORY_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.iter() {
167 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
168 |         let leaf_el = query.memory_leaf.get_unchecked(*index);
169 |         i += 1;
170 |         t.mul_assign_by_base(leaf_el);
171 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.add_assign(&t);
172 |     }
173 |     // single element for stage 2
174 |     {
175 |         let mut t = *powers_of_deep_quotient_challenge.get_unchecked(i);
176 |         let leaf_el =
177 |             query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset
178 |                 + (MEMORY_GRAND_PRODUCT_ACCUMULATOR_POLY_INDEX
179 |                     - VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
180 |                         .stage_2_layout

195 | 
196 |     let mut simulated_from_z_omega = precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega;
197 |     simulated_from_z_omega.sub_assign(&accumulated_at_z_omega);
198 |     simulated_from_z_omega.mul_assign(&divisor_for_z_omega);
199 | 
200 |     let mut expected_value = simulated_from_z;
201 |     expected_value.add_assign(&simulated_from_z_omega);
202 | 
203 |     expected_value
204 | }

206 | pub(crate) unsafe fn accumulate_over_row_for_consistency_check_with_fma(
207 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z: Mersenne31Quartic,
208 |     precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega: Mersenne31Quartic,
209 |     query: &QueryValuesInstance,
210 |     deep_poly_alpha: &Mersenne31Quartic,
211 |     extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega: &Mersenne31Quartic,
212 |     divisor_for_z: &Mersenne31Quartic,
213 |     divisor_for_z_omega: &Mersenne31Quartic,
214 |     tau_in_domain_by_half: &Mersenne31Complex,
215 |     tau_in_domain_by_half_inversed: &Mersenne31Complex,
216 | ) -> Mersenne31Quartic {
217 |     assert!(Mersenne31Quartic::CAN_PROJECT_FROM_BASE);
218 | 
219 |     // now we can do consistency check
220 |     let mut accumulated_at_z;
221 | 
222 |     // it's effectively a Horner rule as we walk backwards
223 | 
224 |     // setup, then witness, then memory, then stage 2 base, then stage 2 ext, then quotient,
225 |     // but all backwards
226 | 
227 |     // quotient is just a single value
228 |     {
229 |         accumulated_at_z = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(query.quotient_leaf);
230 |         // NOTE: we compute quotient at non-main domain first, and then LDE, so we do NOT have adjustment
231 |         // there, and we should cancel one below
232 |         accumulated_at_z.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half_inversed);
233 |     }
234 | 
235 |     let src_ptr = query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset..]
236 |         .as_ptr()
237 |         .cast::<[Mersenne31Field; 4]>();
238 |     let mut i =
239 |         query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset..].len() / 4;
240 |     while i > 0 {
241 |         i -= 1;
242 |         let leaf_el = Mersenne31Quartic::project_ref_from_array(src_ptr.add(i).as_ref_unchecked());
243 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, leaf_el);
244 |     }
245 | 
246 |     // all elements below are in "base field", so we will use an out of cycle value to copy those into for FMA
247 | 
248 |     let mut leaf_value = core::hint::black_box(Mersenne31Quartic::ZERO);
249 | 
250 |     let mut i = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
251 |         .stage_2_layout
252 |         .num_base_field_polys();
253 |     while i > 0 {
254 |         i -= 1;
255 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.stage_2_leaf.get_unchecked(i);
256 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
257 |     }
258 | 
259 |     let mut i = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.memory_layout.total_width;
260 |     while i > 0 {
261 |         i -= 1;
262 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.memory_leaf.get_unchecked(i);
263 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
264 |     }
265 | 
266 |     let mut i = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.witness_layout.total_width;
267 |     while i > 0 {
268 |         i -= 1;
269 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.witness_leaf.get_unchecked(i);
270 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
271 |     }
272 | 
273 |     let mut i = VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.setup_layout.total_width;
274 |     while i > 0 {
275 |         i -= 1;
276 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.setup_leaf.get_unchecked(i);
277 |         accumulated_at_z.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
278 |     }
279 | 
280 |     // all terms are linear over leaf values, so it's enough to scale once
281 |     accumulated_at_z.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half);
282 | 
283 |     let mut simulated_from_z = precompute_with_evals_at_z;
284 |     simulated_from_z.sub_assign(&accumulated_at_z);
285 |     simulated_from_z.mul_assign(&divisor_for_z);
286 | 
287 |     let mut accumulated_at_z_omega;
288 |     // normal sequence is witness - memory - stage 2, so we should reverse for Horner rule
289 | 
290 |     // single element for stage 2
291 |     {
292 |         let leaf_el =
293 |             query.stage_2_leaf[VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT.stage_2_layout.ext4_polys_offset
294 |                 + (MEMORY_GRAND_PRODUCT_ACCUMULATOR_POLY_INDEX
295 |                     - VERIFIER_COMPILED_LAYOUT
296 |                         .stage_2_layout
297 |                         .num_base_field_polys())
298 |                     * 4..]
299 |                 .as_chunks::<4>()
300 |                 .0
301 |                 .iter()
302 |                 .next()
303 |                 .unwrap_unchecked();
304 |         accumulated_at_z_omega = Mersenne31Quartic::from_array_of_base(*leaf_el);
305 |     }
306 | 
307 |     // memory
308 |     let mut i = MEMORY_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.len();
309 |     while i > 0 {
310 |         i -= 1;
311 |         let index = *MEMORY_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.get_unchecked(i);
312 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.memory_leaf.get_unchecked(index);
313 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
314 |     }
315 | 
316 |     // witness
317 |     let mut i = WITNESS_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.len();
318 |     while i > 0 {
319 |         i -= 1;
320 |         let index = *WITNESS_NEXT_ROW_OPENING_INDEXES.get_unchecked(i);
321 |         leaf_value.c0.c0 = *query.witness_leaf.get_unchecked(index);
322 |         accumulated_at_z_omega.fused_mul_add_assign(deep_poly_alpha, &leaf_value);
323 |     }
324 | 
325 |     accumulated_at_z_omega.mul_assign_with_fma(extra_factor_for_accumulation_at_z_omega);
326 | 
327 |     // all terms are linear over leaf values, so it's enough to scale once
328 |     accumulated_at_z_omega.mul_assign_by_base(tau_in_domain_by_half);
329 | 
330 |     let mut simulated_from_z_omega = precompute_with_evals_at_z_omega;
331 |     simulated_from_z_omega.sub_assign(&accumulated_at_z_omega);
332 |     simulated_from_z_omega.mul_assign(&divisor_for_z_omega);
333 | 
334 |     let mut expected_value = simulated_from_z;
335 |     expected_value.add_assign(&simulated_from_z_omega);
336 | 
337 |     expected_value
338 | }
```
